refine ⟨⟨(@yui_aux_0016 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 s t f).1.mpr hf.1, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩

· intro hs m
  exact (@yui_aux_0016 T gamma R h_H002 h_T005 h_T006 h_T007 h_T008 h_T013 (m : ℝ) t f).1.mpr (hs m)
